description: Curtiss C-46F Commando, ex-USAAF 44-78552, operated by Lamb Air. It came down at 09:30 on 13 November 1979 shortly after take-off from Churchill following an engine problem; the three crew were slightly hurt. The airframe remains largely intact beside the Hudson Bay shore, is nicknamed Miss Piggy, and is now a picnic site that visitors can walk into and sit inside. A crash site rather than a curated display.
